description: N48 visual metrics -> DAWproject volume automation. Every column of the values CSV becomes a track, so track count is controlled by narrowing metrics_processing.

video_processing._comment_process_every_nth_frame: Integer video-frame step between analysis rows. Seconds per row = process_every_nth_frame / frames_per_second (15 / 30 = 0.5 s).

metrics_processing._comment_color_channels: Outer product with 'metrics'. Available: R G B Gray S V H000 H060 H120 H180 H240 H300 Hmon. Empty list = all.
metrics_processing._comment_metrics: Available per channel -- combinations that do not exist are skipped. R/G/B/S/V: avg std gmn gs1. H000..H300: int std. Hmon: std. Gray-only camera motion: czd = signed zoom divergence (positive is zoom out), and its half-wave split czi = zoom-in speed, czo = zoom-out speed, cza = zoom speed either way -- each of czi/czo is zero unless the camera is moving that way, so separate sounds can follow each direction. Same split for rotation: crc signed, crl counterclockwise, crr clockwise, cra either way. Gray also has cmv dcd dcl ed0-2 ee0-2 es0-2 ga1-6 gm1-6 gmb gs2-6 rad rsn rss. Empty list = all.
metrics_processing._comment_rank_types: v = raw value, r = percentile rank. Empty = both.
metrics_processing._comment_inversions: o = original, i = 1 - value. Empty = both.
metrics_processing._comment_filter_seconds: Triangular smoothing widths in seconds; converted to the nearest odd number of analysis rows using process_every_nth_frame / frames_per_second. Column suffix _f032s etc.
metrics_processing._comment_block_seconds: Block-average widths in seconds, piecewise constant. Suffix _b016s etc.
metrics_processing._comment_stretch: Logistic stretch: outer product of stretch_values x stretch_centers. If both are empty the identity stretch _s1-0.5 is emitted instead.

dawproject._comment: Every column of the values CSV becomes one track. There is no column list: narrow metrics_processing to get fewer.
dawproject._comment_transport: Cubase overwrites the target project's initial tempo marking and time signature with these on import, so set them to match that project and the import leaves it alone. N48's tempo map starts at 75 bpm in 1/4. Both are always written: Cubase will not load a file with no Tempo, and with no TimeSignature it imposes 4/4 rather than leaving the signature untouched.
